<!-- Keep the title at or under 80 characters, prefix included: one clause naming the outcome you
     want, not the design that would deliver it. Detail belongs in the body.

Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests. -->

**What would you like to be added**:

**Why is this needed**:

**Where the need came from** (tick one):
- [ ] **Blocked** — something cannot be done today; name it, and who ran into it
- [ ] **Asked for** — somebody outside this repository asked for it
- [ ] **Anticipated** — nobody is blocked yet; this is expected to be needed

<!-- "Anticipated" is a legitimate answer and is NOT ranked below the others — a good deal of useful
     work starts there. It is asked because it changes the burden, not the welcome.

     An anticipated need has no user behind it yet, so the body should also say who would configure
     this and what they would be trying to do. An anticipated need is very often right about the
     problem and early about the shape, and the two are worth separating: documentation, an admission
     warning or a status condition can carry a problem until somebody is actually blocked by it, and
     each of those is far easier to take back than an API field.

     The question to answer before this becomes API surface is whether the field would tell us
     anything we cannot already read. One that asks a user to restate what they have already
     declared adds a second copy that can disagree with the first. -->

**Completion requirements**:

This enhancement requires the following artifacts:

- [ ] Design doc
- [ ] API change
- [ ] Docs update

The artifacts should be linked in subsequent comments.
